ablation: static residual-network periphery score with no centrality migration term
allocation: fixed slots min(0.25, 1/K); unused slots cash
cash_rule: no positive qualified score means cash
contamination_notes: 2016-2022 reused research/development; 2025+ previously viewed diagnostics; live excluded
cost_hypothesis: weekly topology state changes slowly enough to keep turnover bounded
failure_mode: edge collapses into residual momentum or static low-correlation selection
falsifier: rotate current asset topology assignments across sorted asset labels while preserving the graph-state distribution
nearest_incumbent: C165 / residual-dispersion and V10 residual-momentum families
portfolio_role: orthogonal topology satellite during cross-sectional fragmentation
primitive: Quantiacs daily OHLCV and historical is_liquid only
selection: positive scores, top-K, deterministic label tie breaks
selection_objective: minimum research/dev Sharpe across 0.04/0.08/0.12 ATR cost; then worst DD, lower turnover, id
source_notes: Mechanism selected from the repository frontier before performance inspection; current campaign does not use public performance claims.
stop_rule: freeze if falsifier or ablation matches/beats base development score; no automatic promotion
thesis: During residual-correlation fragmentation, assets migrating from crowded centrality toward the network periphery while retaining positive residual trend exhibit persistent idiosyncratic leadership.
timing: completed daily returns; graph estimated only from trailing residual returns; rebalance-day topology compared with a fixed 21-day-prior graph
validation: 2023-2024 only after freeze; never drives mutation
